entries.claim: The bomb is one CZBombState a round with six states -- 0 reset, 1 on the ground, 2 carried, 3 planted, 4 defused, 5 detonated -- taking 1 -> 2 (pickup), 2 -> 1 (drop), 2 -> 3 (plant), 3 -> 4 (defuse) and 3 -> 5 (the host's fuse); a round starts it on the ground at StartBomb with no carrier, planter, fuse or cooldown.

entries.claim: The plant and the defuse are a 5 s hold of the Action button reset on a release, committing on its 300th 60 Hz frame; the room advances it one a tick while the player's latest command run says ActionHeld while eligible (ACT.R8, 2026-10-08), live until HOLD_LIVE_TICKS_PLACEHOLDER (15) ticks pass with no command (then paused, not reset), so any honest page commits in 300 ticks and a flood in exactly 300; the page predicts it one a command.

the hold runs on the room's ticks while the latest command holds (ACT.R8): a 60-a-second page in batches of 4 plants on the hold's 300th tick; a hold begun and ended in one tick is told once; a release inside a batch resets it
slow honest pages plant in the original's 5 s (ACT.R8): a 15-fps page sending one held command a frame and a 5-fps page sending 6 every 12 ticks plant on the hold's 300th tick
a stall pauses the hold, it does not reset it: 20 ticks with no command mid-hold count the first 14 (HOLD_LIVE_TICKS_PLACEHOLDER = 15) and the hold resumes at the next held command, 6 ticks late
a flood cannot hurry the hold: 600 held commands sent at once after 10 s of nothing, then one a tick, plant on the hold's 300th tick exactly; the excess is queued, not dropped
the defuse the same (ACT.R8): a 15-fps page's one held command a frame defuses on the hold's 300th tick, and a flood then one a tick no sooner

entries.claim: The action is the head of the picker's list, which FUN_0021f850 rebuilds each frame from the action mask (1 << action) appending in a fixed order: 0x80000 / 0x100000 (actions 19 / 20, the turret's mount and release; mounted, the release alone), 0x80 (action 7, the bomb's plant or defuse), 0x10000 (the ladder slide), 0x4 (the climb), 0x2000 (action 13, a door or switch), 0x40000 (C4, item 0x97), 0x200000 (action 21, the victory dance), 0x10 / 0x20 (actions 4 / 5, a weapon's pickup), 0x4000 / 0x8000 (a hostage's order), 0x40 (action 6, the drop) last -- so the carrier aimed down at a C4 target places C4, and offered together the turret is the head and the victory point comes before a pickup (AD-6, 2026-10-16; was: the turret's mount after C4, TURRET_ACTION_BIT_READING, and the pickup after C4, both retired); the list's rotation by a second input is not built (ACTION_LIST_ROTATE_READING); each context's HUD prompt is research 87 s5's (the defuse's DEFUSE_PROMPT_ICON_READING).

entries.claim: DEMOLITION on Crossroads launched from the game lobby is the original's round: the bomb on the ground at StartBomb (1279.762, 47.334, 1446.111) is taken up by the SEAL who walks onto it (state 2, ret_base on the carrier's compass, THE BOMB HAS BEEN PICKED UP), planted at terrorist_tent by a 5 s hold and the 2.25 s placement (state 3, a 30 s fuse in the timer's place), defused by a Terrorist's 5 s hold (state 4, the Terrorists' win 3 + 20 + 1 s after), detonating 30 s after a plant left alone (state 5, destroy_terrorist_base, the SEALs' win 2 + 2 + 20 + 1 s after), and a round that runs its clock out is a draw with the bomb untouched.
entries.source: research 214 s1-s3 (switch_timer @3844, BOMB_RESULT_DELAY_READING, modeRules(2).timeoutWinner null); disc RUN/MP72.ZDB StartBomb and terrorist_tent (research 213 s5)
